panels.title: Sync outcome, bytes and delta ratio

options.content: **Not shown.** sync_result carries an outcome, bytes and a delta ratio (Appendix G.2), but the rollups keep only its duration, so success rates, transferred bytes and the delta ratio cannot be read from `analytics_rollups` (ANL-010).

panels.title: Sync duration by device class
panels.description: Duration of sync_result per device class; p50, p90 and p99 are bucket edges.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT r.device_class AS grp, u.idx - 1 AS k, SUM(u.n) AS n
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(r.histogram) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(n, idx)
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'sync_result'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), cum AS (
  SELECT grp, k,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY k) AS run,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY grp) AS total
  FROM hist
), edges AS (
  SELECT grp,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.50 * total) AS p50,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.90 * total) AS p90,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.99 * total) AS p99
  FROM cum
  GROUP BY grp
), totals AS (
  SELECT r.device_class AS grp, SUM(r.value_count) AS samples,
    SUM(r.value_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(r.value_count), 0) AS mean, MAX(r.value_max) AS max
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'sync_result'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t.grp AS "Device class", t.samples AS "Samples", ROUND(t.mean) AS "Mean (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p50 + 1, 15)] AS "p50 (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p90 + 1, 15)] AS "p90 (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p99 + 1, 15)] AS "p99 (ms)",
  t.max AS "Max (ms)"
FROM totals t
LEFT JOIN edges e ON e.grp = t.grp
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Syncs over time by device class
panels.description: sync_result events per bucket, one series per device class.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.device_class AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'sync_result'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

options.content: **Partly shown.** Latency is per plugin, from function_call durations. The function name and the status (success or error, Appendix G.2) are not rollup dimensions, so a per-function error rate needs a rollup dimension (ANL-010).

panels.title: Function latency by plugin
panels.description: Duration of function_call per plugin; p50, p90 and p99 are bucket edges.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT r.plugin_key AS grp, u.idx - 1 AS k, SUM(u.n) AS n
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(r.histogram) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(n, idx)
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'function_call'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), cum AS (
  SELECT grp, k,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY k) AS run,
    SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY grp) AS total
  FROM hist
), edges AS (
  SELECT grp,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.50 * total) AS p50,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.90 * total) AS p90,
    MIN(k) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.99 * total) AS p99
  FROM cum
  GROUP BY grp
), totals AS (
  SELECT r.plugin_key AS grp, SUM(r.value_count) AS samples,
    SUM(r.value_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(r.value_count), 0) AS mean, MAX(r.value_max) AS max
  FROM analytics_rollups r
  WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'function_call'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t.grp AS "Plugin", t.samples AS "Samples", ROUND(t.mean) AS "Mean (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p50 + 1, 15)] AS "p50 (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p90 + 1, 15)] AS "p90 (ms)",
  (ARRAY[1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000,60000])[LEAST(e.p99 + 1, 15)] AS "p99 (ms)",
  t.max AS "Max (ms)"
FROM totals t
LEFT JOIN edges e ON e.grp = t.grp
ORDER BY 1;
